Master Mind Scholarship Details

The Master Mind Scholarship is a prestigious award, providing a grant of €10,225 alongside a tuition fee waiver for each academic year, calculated for 60 ECTS.

The grant, distributed in instalments, is designed to substantially cover accommodation, insurance, and a major portion of living expenses.

We will provide the detail information about the requirements, and selection criteria and how to apply for the Master Mind Scholarship in this post.
Master Mind Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the postgraduate Master Mind Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:
Applicants must enroll in a master’s degree at a Flemish higher education institution.
They should exhibit high academic performance and/or potential:

    A minimum GPA of 3.5 out of 4.0 is required. More information on GPA calculation can be found at https://www.scholaro.com/gpa-calculator/.

English language proficiency is a must:

    IELTS: Minimum overall band score of 7.0.
    TOEFL: Minimum total score of 94.
    C1 level as per the Common European Framework of Reference, or equivalent in another recognized test.

Online IELTS (IELTS Indicator) and TOEFL (TOEFL iBT Special Home Edition) tests are also valid.
For students applying to schools of arts:

    IELTS: Minimum overall band score of 6.5.
    TOEFL: Minimum total score of 90.
    B2 level as per the Common European Framework of Reference, or equivalent in another recognized test.
The host institution must accept the student after an academic review.
Applicants can be nominated by only one Flemish higher education institution. If preselected by multiple institutions, they must choose one for their application.
All nationalities, except Russian, can apply. Applicants must have a degree from a non-Flemish institution. Credit mobility students in Flemish institutions are also eligible.
Students already enrolled in a Flemish institution are ineligible, except those in specific preparatory programs aiming for a master’s in September 2024.
Students enrolling in preparatory, bridging programs, distance learning, or those spending more than half their credits outside Flanders and Brussels are not eligible.

Required Documents for MasterMind Scholarship 2026 Belgium

While applying for the Master Mind Scholarship 2026, you will be required to submit the following documents;

    Passport photo
    International passport or national ID
    Curriculum Vitae, including GPA and other academic credentials
    Transcript of records with certified translations if not in Dutch, French, German, or English
    English language test results or exemption letter
    Motivation letter in English
    Two recommendation letters in English from professors or recent employers
    Copies of diplomas with certified translations if necessary
